method: all 82 certificate records of the warm-multiband (35), warm-multiband2 (31), cost-70c warm6 (6), cost-70c warm-batch3 (4) and warm-band-hygiene (6) record files resolved to their published certificate bytes (single files or .part1of2/.part2of2 line-boundary splits in the band certificate directories), byte-checked against the per-record bytes/md5 (and per-part bytes/md5 where documented), then independently verified with the published BigInt 3x3-cofactor verifier (verify_win7_certificate_bigint_independent.mjs, no engine, no floating point) with per-record row / sub_roots_pass / root_hex / union / terminal-range equality asserted
layout_drift_note: six records declare 'single file' storage while the repo holds a part1of2/part2of2 split (cost63a bits 96/97, cost64b bits 53/116, cost61d bits 114/116); the concatenated parts match the record bytes and full-certificate md5 exactly, so the drift is presentational, not substantive
duplicate_file_note: the warm-band-hygiene cost-61d bit-22 record and cost-71b bit-1 record reference the same certificate file (same root 00000000000000803202000000400002); the verifier ran once for it
interpretation_guard: bookkeeping over published certificates; solved counts measure manifest coverage, not the game-theoretic value of any position; WIN7 certificates prove only individual 7-stone roots within depth 10
